hypothesis.title: Deployment blocked by temporary downstream dependency outage (PostgreSQL maintenance)
hypothesis.description: CI/CD deployment of app-api-v2.3.0 timed out after 30 minutes because the application cannot initialize – it depends on PostgreSQL (postgres-svc.prod-infra:5432), which is currently unavailable due to a scheduled maintenance window that started at 15:30. The maintenance was estimated to complete in 10 minutes.

recommended_actions.title: Verify maintenance completion and service restoration
recommended_actions.description: Check the PostgreSQL maintenance status (maintenance ID: maint-2026-01-09-1) to confirm it has completed and the service port 5432 is restored. Monitor the postgres_up metric in Prometheus to verify.

recommended_actions.title: Retry deployment after service is healthy
recommended_actions.description: Once PostgreSQL is confirmed healthy, retry the deployment. The rollout should succeed if the dependency is restored. Consider: Should the timeout window have been longer given known maintenance windows?

recommended_actions.title: Coordinate CI/CD and maintenance scheduling
recommended_actions.description: Future deployments should avoid maintenance windows. Establish a contract: maintenance teams must notify CI/CD or disable automated deployments during scheduled outages. Consider using a maintenance-aware deployment scheduler.
